title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Latest RemoteOK inventory validated for target-family scope and Canadian regional eligibility. Scores measure technical and domain fit only.
latest_update: Rechecked September 21, 2026 — no eligible target-family postings this run; full-review exclusions (Harper, KPI Solutions) are now scored rows in the table below instead of a footer list, per the updated report_schema.md convention.

notes_sections.heading: Could not validate
items: Golang Kubernetes Engineer — Arango (posted September 16, plausible Platform-family fit): the API description is truncated to marketing boilerplate and an anti-spam instruction with no real requirements; the canonical detail page also would not expose full requirements, employment type, or confirmed regional eligibility without a Premium unlock (salary shown as “Upgrade to Premium to see salary”). Not scored per the validation rule — a snippet is not sufficient. View posting. (Repeat unresolved case from the 2026-09-19 run — still incomplete in the current inventory window.)

notes_sections.heading: Search limitations
items: The public API returned 99 job objects; 24 were dated within the preferred 14-day window (since 2026-09-07).
The API is a latest-inventory feed, not a dedicated keyword-search endpoint — the full returned inventory was reviewed for target titles, tags, and description signals.

Three additional postings carried a bare 'devops' tag (DESARROLLADOR FULL STACK — Kruger NearShore/Rekluti; Staff Software Development Engineer SDM — Delinea; Staff Software Engineer — unnamed) but their titles and full tag sets read as generalist full-stack/software-engineering roles, not DevOps/Platform/SRE center of gravity — screened out by title, not opened in full.
No eligible, unclear, or known-pipeline target-family role surfaced this run. No CAPTCHA, verification page, or write-side action occurred.

Several RemoteOK postings scored in the 2026-08-25 run (Akuity, DoiT, Lemon.io, Livepeer, Shakepay — all Skipped in applications.md as of 2026-09-19) have rolled off the API's ~100-item latest-inventory window and were not part of today's inventory.

rows.title: Engineering Manager, TLM Platform
rows.location: San Francisco — “Based in SF or willing to relocate,” fully on-site, no remote option
rows.gap: Real substance — owns infrastructure, developer productivity, and SRE/production support, with hands-on AWS/GCP, Kubernetes, and Docker requirements — but on-site San Francisco with no remote option is outside the reachable-city range (Ottawa, Kingston, Brockville, Cornwall, Montréal), a hard geography gate on its own. Separately it's a formal Engineering Manager role (flexible on tenure but still people-management scope), a different shape than Marc's ‘leads without authority’ positioning. Reviewed in full via the canonical detail page. Repeat posting from the 2026-09-18/09-19 runs, still live.

rows.title: Software Deployment Engineer
rows.location: Cincinnati, OH (on-site delivery, plus remote/office phases)
rows.gap: Despite the ‘Deployment Engineer’ title, the actual work is warehouse-automation hardware/software commissioning — pick-to-light systems, overhead illuminators, AutoStore/T-sort integration, on-site installation and IQ/UAT sign-off for a supply-chain systems integrator. Not a software CI/CD or infrastructure deployment role; no cloud, IaC, or platform-engineering component. Reviewed in full.
